resolution.note: ship drops unknown record keys, deliver prints refusals and ignores unmerged stale state; enum values move to t-5gc1q76

title: Ship review-record schema changes and print deliver ship refusals
body:
Outcome: a change to the review record schema can ship with its own review record. krn ship verifies records with the trusted base schema, so a record using a new field (PR #170: prior.source, role 'prepass') is refused ('review record does not satisfy the strict schema', ship --dry-run exit 1) and the PR needs an extra review attempt run in the old shape. Also: krn deliver exited 76 with empty stdout and stderr instead of printing the ship refusal.
Evidence: .krn/runs/lead/prepass-prior/deliver.exit (76), deliver.out (0 bytes); hand ship --dry-run printed the refusal.
Lead trap: when a PR changes the review record schema, run its last review attempt in the base record shape (no new fields) under a budget exception; when deliver exits 76 silently, run krn ship --dry-run by hand to read the refusal.

After a new head, krn deliver resumes stale state and exits 71 "bind: record/PR head mismatch"; workaround in krn-lead step 8: delete .krn/runs/deliver/<series>/{state.json,review.json,merge-message.txt} and rerun (seen on #170).
